# mef3io

> mef3io reads and writes MEF 3.0 (Multiscale Electrophysiology Format) recordings from Python, MATLAB and C++, with one C++ core behind all three. MEF 3.0 is a compressed, optionally encrypted format for long electrophysiology recordings (mainly EEG, intracranial EEG and ECG; any regularly sampled signal fits). Files mef3io writes open in meflib, pymef and mef_tools, and theirs open in mef3io.

Install: `pip install mef3io` (Python 3.10+, numpy only). MATLAB: the mef3io-matlab zip on each GitHub release. C++: add `core/` to a CMake project. Times are microseconds since the Unix epoch (uUTC). Gaps read back as NaN. `from mef3io import MefReader, MefWriter` replaces the legacy mef_tools API. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/): what mef3io is, scope and limitations
- [MEF 3.0 for students](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/students/): the format in plain words, when to use it
- [Install](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/install/): wheels, MATLAB bundle, building from source
- [Python guide](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/python/): Reader, Writer, inspect, cancel/progress, tar archives, caching, mef_tools drop-in
- [MATLAB guide](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/matlab/): the +mef3io classes
- [C++ and C ABI guide](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/cpp/): the core library and the flat C API
- [Examples](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/examples/): runnable scripts

## How-to

- [Convert EDF, EDF+ or BDF to MEF 3.0](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/howto/edf_to_mef/): sampling rates, units, time zone, annotations, EDF+D gaps, patient fields, verification (`pip install "mef3io[edf]"`)
- [Read MEF 3.0 in Python](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/howto/read_python/): whole channel, time windows, gaps as NaN, passwords, .mefd.tar
- [Read MEF 3.0 in MATLAB](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/howto/read_matlab/): the same in MATLAB
- [Long recordings with gaps](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/howto/long_recordings/): how gaps are stored, finding them without reading samples, appending over days

## Reference

- [MEF 3.0 on-disk format](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/mef3_format/): every file and field
- [Encryption model](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/encryption_model/): the two password levels and what they protect
- [Validation and repair](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/validation/): checking, repairing and recovering sessions
- [Long recordings](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/long_recordings/): months-long appends, durability
- [De-identification](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/anonymization/): why meflib's recording-time offset is not anonymization
- [Release notes](https://bnelair.github.io/mef3io/release_notes/): changes and upgrade notes per version

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/bnelair/mef3io)
- [meflib](https://github.com/msel-source/meflib): the reference C library; its meflib.h is the MEF 3.0 specification
- [pymef](https://github.com/msel-source/pymef) and [mef_tools](https://github.com/bnelair/mef_tools): the legacy Python stack
- [mef3io-studio](https://github.com/bnelair/mef3io-studio): desktop app for exploring and anonymizing MEF 3.0 recordings
- [mef3io-server](https://github.com/bnelair/mef3io-server): gRPC server streaming MEF 3.0 data to viewers on a local network
